I am an old woman now, 72 years, and my strength is not what it used to be. On this small plot near my home I grow cassava and some sweet potatoes, the way my mother taught me. I cannot afford the chemical fertilizer from the shop in town, and anyway cassava grows well enough in our soil here in Kigoma without it. I will put the manure from my few goats and chickens on the plot, use the cuttings I saved from last year's harvest, and my daughter-in-law and grandchildren will help me with the weeding and harvesting.
